newsitem.title: POLAND: Handlowy rates Kutno as long-term "buy".
newsitem.headline: Handlowy rates Kutno as long-term "buy".

text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish Bank Handlowy SA rated pharmaceuticals firm Polfa Kutno SA as a long-term buy and a short-term hold, saying it had prospects of maintaining strong market position despite growing competition.

Handlowy said in its report dated January 31, but released on Monday, Polfa Kutno was likely to benefit from expected growth in domestic demand but excessive employment levels kept costs of wages and salaries high.
"We recommend buying shares of Polfa Kutno to long-term investors. We base our recommendation on the company's strong fundamentals in the area of basic products," the report said.

It said plans for introducing new products and further growth in exports should improve the firm's profitability, but competition from Hungarian, Croatian and Western firms, which Polfa Kutno was facing, might counteract the growth.
It said it expected Polfa Kutno's net profit to rise to 21 million zlotys in 1997 from last year's 15.8 million on sales of 230 million against 171 million in 1996.
